name: Mikara Cafe
notes: 5 photos: two printed board menus (1,2) and three TV-screen menus (3,4,5) showing overlapping sections at different prices (e.g. Avocado Toast $12.99 printed vs $10 on TV; BLT $12.99 vs $9). Used the printed board pricing where sections overlap and pulled Flatbreads/Salad (TV-only, no printed equivalent) from photo 3. Dual-size drink prices (e.g. Americano 4/5, Hot Latte 5.5/6.5) are given as a single price where the smaller size is listed alone, otherwise omitted.
